cohort: Preterm infants with a birth weight <1500 g or gestational age <32 weeks, admitted to Shanghai Children's Hospital between April 2019 and March 2023.
finding: An elevated Bacteroidetes/Firmicutes (B/F) ratio was observed before the onset of Neonatal Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC), suggesting it may serve as a predictive biomarker.
